MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 1

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x

3. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 2
   D. 1

4. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 8
   C. 64
   D. 32

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 45
   C. 18
   D. 30

6. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 43
   D. 1

7. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2, 4, 6
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 1, 6
   D. 3, 6, 9

8. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 1/2
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

9. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31.7
   C. 31
   D. 37

10. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 3/4
   D. 2/3

11. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 21
   C. 15
   D. 15.7

12. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.205
   D. 0.025

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 22
   C. 28
   D. 33

14. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.6
   C. 23.7
   D. 23

15. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 1

16. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27
   C. 33
   D. 27.7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
